jobs.title: Open Application
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

We're always interested in meeting thoughtful, driven people who are excited about what we’re building at Render, even if there isn’t a specific role open that matches your background today.

The Open Application is designed for candidates who believe they could contribute to Render across engineering, product, design, go-to-market, operations, or other functions as we continue to grow. Submitting an application here allows our team to learn more about you and consider you for current or future roles as they open.

This role is not tied to a single team, level, or function. Instead, it serves as a way to start a conversation as our hiring needs evolve.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities will vary depending on the team and role, but candidates considered through this application may:

  • Help build, scale, or support Render’s cloud platform, products, or internal systems

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to solve meaningful technical and operational problems

  • Contribute to improving the experience of developers and teams building on Render

  • Bring a thoughtful, user-focused approach to problem-solving and execution

We're Looking For

  • Experience in a relevant discipline (engineering, product, design, go-to-market, operations, or related fields), with a desire to own meaningful problems and see work through to real outcomes

  • A high bar for quality in how you build, communicate, and collaborate, with care for both the details and the broader impact of your work

  • The ability to reason clearly through complex or ambiguous problems, make thoughtful decisions, and execute with urgency when it matters

  • A collaborative mindset and interest in building together, partnering across teams, and contributing to an environment of trust, respect, and constructive debate

  • Alignment with Render’s Operating Principles and the way we operate day to day, including ownership of outcomes, raising the quality bar, moving quickly with intention, and taking a long-term view

Nice-to-Haves:

Depending on the role, additional experience that may be helpful includes:

  • Background in cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or SaaS platforms

  • Experience working at a high-growth startup or scaling organization

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, modern web applications, or AI-enabled products

  • A strong interest in building tools that empower other builders

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

About the Role

Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy-to-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes.

By joining us at an early stage, you will design and build the cloud platform you've always wanted for yourself, and make decisions that will shape our product and company, directly impacting developers around the globe.

The challenge is in building the right user-facing features and abstractions that make simple application deployments effortless and complex application deployments possible. User experience is our primary focus and drives everything we do. As a product engineer at Render, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of full stack projects. You should already have experience building products across the stack and have a keen understanding of databases, web frameworks, APIs, and multiple programming languages.

What You'll Do

  • Build new products. These are new services to make Render more powerful and valuable to our users. We are continuously building new and easier ways for our users to build their applications.

  • Collaborate closely with design, product, other engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Help evolve and mature the Render codebase and technology as the product scales and increases in complexity over time.

  • Participate in team planning, roadmapping, and goal-setting.

  • Help shape team culture and practices as the company scales.

  • Participate in on-call responsibilities with the rest of your team.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of professional experience shipping software. Bonus points if you’ve excelled at a small, high-growth startup.

  • Experience collaborating with product and design stakeholders.

  • Experience wearing multiple hats and working across the stack, both collaboratively and independently.

  • Strong understanding of web frameworks, APIs, and databases, experience working with multiple programming languages, and working in a distributed system.

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to make pragmatic decisions about your work.

Nice-to-haves

  • Familiarity with modern tooling for software build and deploy processes.

  • Familiarity building for product-driven growth and modern enterprise audiences.

  • Experience with any of the technologies the Render product runs on: Go, Typescript, React, Kubernetes, Postgres, Terraform, Temporal.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

The Render Security team is a small, dedicated team of engineers that runs all things security at Render.

  • Full-Stack Security Ownership - We don't just monitor; we build. From custom security tooling to comprehensive threat assessment, we own the entire security lifecycle at Render.

  • Engineering-First Approach - We are a team of engineers that understand security deeply, we create solutions that integrate seamlessly with development workflows rather than creating friction.

  • Proactive - We stay ahead of threats through continuous assessment, automated monitoring, and rapid response.

By joining Render at an early stage, you will be directly involved with building out foundational security for Render and make decisions that will shape our product and company, directly impacting developers around the globe.

You will:

  • Build internal tooling to enable secure access to resources (e.g., wrappers, utilities, authentication services, and proxies).

  • Implement detection and monitoring systems that alert the team to high signal vulnerabilities

  • Analyze and assess security issues identified through threat modeling, penetration testing, security scans and vulnerability disclosure.

  • Work with developers on sensitive code paths and educate them on secure design patterns.

  • Liaise with customers regarding their security and compliance needs, and in return, inform our security program.

  • Communicate security risks and solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders as part of company-wide planning and prioritization processes.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest security threats, vulnerabilities, and best practices and make recommendations for improvements to our security posture.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to inform and build thoughtful security features for our customers.

  • Continually ensure that our systems have appropriate authentication, authorization, and accounting with low internal overhead.

We're looking for:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering or security.

  • Experience designing and building secure web applications, tools, and APIs.

  • Experience with vulnerability review and analysis

  • Strong incident leadership and diligent response.

  • Empathy toward the rest of the team and our customers

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to make pragmatic decisions about your work.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Detection engineering experience through implementation and maintenance of a SIEM.

  • Experience with any of the technologies the Render product runs on: Go, Typescript, Kubernetes, Postgres, Terraform, Temporal.

  • Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI.

  • Proven expertise in exploiting common security vulnerabilities, demonstrating practical experience in identifying and leveraging vulnerabilities to assess security posture.

  • Experience securing applications and systems through threat modelling and risk assessments.

  • Active participation and contributions to the security community through public research, blogging, presentations, and other means.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy-to-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes.

We are scaling rapidly. Our customers have created hundreds of thousands of services on our platform, and the numbers continue to accelerate. Our customers trust us to deliver a secure, reliable and performant cloud — this is our top priority as a company.

By joining us at an early stage, you will design and build the cloud platform you've always wanted for yourself, and make decisions that will shape our product and company, directly impacting developers around the globe.

We are looking for engineers with deep specialization in cloud infrastructure. We are particularly interested in experience with container orchestration, low-level networking, and storage management.

Areas of focus will be improving our architecture to schedule & spin up containers orders of magnitude faster, develop offerings to support our customers' growing AI workloads, improving the performance of and adding new features to our internal traffic routing & load balancing, and building low-level primitives to enable our users to massively parallelize data processing workloads.

What You'll Do

  • Own Render's core infrastructure across multiple data centers and regions.

  • Help offer unique capabilities to Render customers through infrastructure innovation.

  • Plan and architect for rapidly increasing scale.

  • Debug issues at all levels in our infrastructure stack.

  • Improve the performance and reliability of our infrastructure through increased observability, load testing, and chaos engineering.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to help keep our platform stable, predictable, and secure.

  • Participate in our on-call rotation, with the rest of the engineering team.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of experience building and scaling cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience developing, maintaining, and debugging production systems at scale.

  • Experience building, operating and scaling Kubernetes clusters or similar resource/container orchestration.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, Pulumi, and Ansible.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Linux kernel and/or container optimization

  • Familiarity with observability tools like Datadog, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience hosting PostgreSQL (or similar data stores) at scale.

  • Security hardening skills, especially in the context of untrusted workloads.

Relevant Links from the Render Engineering Team

  • SEV0 SF 2025 | Boundary Cases: Technical and social challenges in cross-system debugging

  • Kubernetes Informers are so easy... to misuse!

  • How Render Scaled Knative to 100k+ Web Apps

  • Distributing Global State to Serve over 1 Billion Daily Requests

  • How Render Enforces Access Controls with Go Generics

  • Breaking down OpenAI's outage: How to avoid a hidden DNS dependency in Kubernetes

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

This role requires technical depth, precision, and strong cross-functional collaboration. You’ll be the engineer others depend on to make sure usage data flows seamlessly, customers are charged correctly, and our systems are robust against complexity at scale.

You will:

  • Build, operate, and improve Render’s usage-based billing systems.

  • Integrate with and maintain third-party billing systems (e.g., Orb, Metronome, or similar).

  • Collaborate closely with Finance, Product, and Support Engineering teams to ensure accurate, reliable billing and reporting.

  • Work with large-scale databases and data pipelines to capture, transform, and reconcile usage data.

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve billing reliability and performance.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions about how billing integrates with the broader Render platform.

  • Help shape internal processes, documentation, and best practices for billing operations.

We're looking for:

  • 3+ years of professional experience building or operating usage-based billing systems.

  • Hands-on experience integrating and working with third-party billing systems such as Orb, Metronome, Stripe, or similar platforms.

  • Strong expertise in Go and production-grade databases (SQL or NoSQL).

  • Ability to work effectively across functions with Finance, Customer Experience, and Product teams.

  • Detail-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability in mission-critical systems.

  • Pragmatism and problem-solving skills to balance accuracy, scalability, and developer experience.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience working in a high-growth startup or scaling environment.

  • Familiarity with financial reconciliation and reporting processes.

  • Background in distributed systems or event-driven architectures.

  • Willingness to mentor others and help scale Render’s engineering culture.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision and roadmap for Render's infrastructure platform. This is a role for someone who wants to define what a modern cloud platform looks like in an era where AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built and run.

You'll drive the technical and strategic direction for Render's core platform, working directly with infrastructure engineering to shape architectural decisions. You’ll engage with Render's customers and our product development teams to develop a deep understanding of their needs and build conviction about where the platform needs to go next.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the the foundational primitives upon which everything at Render is built. Your scope spans compute & orchestration, network topology, traffic, and routing features, and data storage infrastructure..

  • Drive prioritization across Render's platform investments, balancing the leverage of foundational capabilities against near-term product and business needs and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs.

  • Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's core infrastructure, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for long-term reliability, performance, and extensibility. You’ll own the base layer of our stack, so having the dexterity to understand the shape of our other Product investment areas is essential.

  • Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how Render's platform primitives need to evolve to serve AI-native builders, from compute and orchestration to storage and runtime.

  • Set the standard for how product teams build on Render's platform, providing clear guidance, boundaries, and abstractions that make it easy for other product leaders and external customers to ship with confidence.

We're looking for:

  • 7+ years in Product Management, with the majority spent on developer tools, infrastructure, or platform products.

  • General knowledge of how AI is being used by modern teams. Bonus if you have strong perspective on the future of agentic memory management and compute workloads.

  • Deep developer empathy, for both internal engineering teams and our customers, and the technical depth to make sound architectural tradeoffs in collaboration with engineering.

  • A track record of taking ambiguous, cross-cutting platform problems and turning them into clear strategy and shipped outcomes.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills.

What would be nice to have but not required:

  • Experience as an infrastructure engineer.

  • Experience building AI agents or infrastructure.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

In order to deliver Render to our users, we must first provide the best internal developer platform for engineers to move fast, confidently, reliably, and securely along paved paths with the right set of tools, observability and guardrails. As Engineering Manager for the newly formed Platform team, you’ll lead a growing group of talented engineers — both established team members and future hires — who are energized by the opportunity to build this space alongside you.

Together, you will modernize and bring Render's internal developer platform and shared production infrastructure (observability, CI/CD, developer environments, storage, and more) from good to great. Because the landscape we operate in is evolving rapidly, we build infrastructure that is modular and adaptable, able to support a product direction that is itself responding to a fast-moving market without over-indexing on any single bet. This team will have tremendous impact; unlike most infrastructure teams that build for internal consumers, our infrastructure is the product. Not only will you be enhancing the velocity and impact of your fellow Render engineers, but the 4.5 million developers using our platform as well.

You’ll be responsible for guiding technical direction, developing engineers, and ensuring the team ships meaningful improvements quickly while maintaining the high standards that define Render’s platform.   • Lead and grow a team of platform engineers, supporting their development through mentorship, feedback, and clear technical guidance.

  • Engage deeply in technical discussions, guiding system design decisions and helping the team navigate architectural tradeoffs.

  • Stay up to date with relevant industry trends, emerging tools, and developer practices that will inform future team learning and opportunities for investment.

  • Help the team break down complex problems into incremental milestones that deliver value quickly while supporting long-term platform evolution.

  • Ensure teams maintain a strong understanding of the developer experience and reliability, security, and velocity impact of the features they build.

  • Partner closely with other teams like Runtime, Security, and Product to understand needs, align priorities, and ensure delivery of impactful features and solutions through thoughtful technical solutions and product roadmaps.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years as an Engineer on an Infrastructure or similarly shaped team shipping products or features for other developers.

  • 4+ years of experience managing people and developing engineers, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.

  • Strong technical background with the ability to engage deeply in system design, architecture, and engineering tradeoffs.

  • Ability to translate engineering goals and user needs into roadmaps and shipped features.

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both team outcomes and long-term system health.

  • Experience improving Reliability and/or Developer Experience through tooling, processes, and team practices.

  • Deep experience with open source technologies supporting an internal platform tool or cluster, build & deployment systems, CI/CD, observability, and/or configuration management.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background working on highly scalable distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.

  • Experience on teams managing large fleets of developer environments, sandboxes, or testing ecosystems.

  • Experience building platforms and/or products used directly by developers.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy-to-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes.

We are scaling rapidly. Our customers have created hundreds of thousands of services on our platform, and the numbers continue to accelerate. Our customers trust us to deliver a secure, reliable and performant cloud — this is our top priority as a company.

By joining us at an early stage, you will design and build the cloud platform you've always wanted for yourself, and make decisions that will shape our product and company, directly impacting developers around the globe.

Render builds and operates our own networking stack end-to-end. We leverage open source and industry-standard technologies, modifying and extending the core components to meet the unique reliability, performance, and scaling demands of our platform.

We are looking for engineers with deep specialization in network infrastructure, particularly with experience in edge/ingress networking and Kubernetes networking internals.

Areas of focus include scaling and evolving our traffic routing and load balancing systems; advancing Kubernetes and Linux networking components to support large-scale, zero-downtime operation; and exploring networking for Render’s next-generation compute platforms.

What You'll Do

  • Own Render's core network infrastructure across multiple data centers and cloud providers. Shape how networking evolves as Render rapidly scales.

  • Design and build customer-facing networking capabilities that give users greater flexibility in how their services connect, communicate, and how traffic is routed.

  • Investigate complex networking issues across the stack, from the kernel and data plane to distributed systems and edge networking.

  • Drive performance and reliability improvements through systematic profiling and tuning.

  • Partner with engineers across the company to build a platform that is stable, predictable, and secure.

  • Participate in our on-call rotation. Help continuously improve how we detect, respond to, and learn from incidents.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale networking or infrastructure systems.

  • Experience with Kubernetes networking internals (e.g. kube-proxy, CNI plugins, service routing) or similar container networking technology.

  • Experience with Linux networking internals (e.g. routing, netfilter/iptables/nftables, conntrack) in production environments.

  • Experience building and operating traffic routing systems (e.g. load balancers, ingress, proxies) at scale.

  • Strong experience designing, debugging, and operating distributed systems.

  • Experience planning and executing high-risk changes with minimal downtime.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with eBPF or advanced Linux kernel networking.

  • Experience developing systems in Go or similar languages that interact with low-level OS and networking primitives.

Relevant Links from the Render Engineering Team

  • The Namespaces Scaling Trap (video podcast interview) and related article How We Found 7 TiB of Memory Just Sitting Around

  • SEV0 SF 2025 | Boundary Cases: Technical and social challenges in cross-system debugging

  • Distributing Global State to Serve over 1 Billion Daily Requests

  • Breaking down OpenAI's outage: How to avoid a hidden DNS dependency in Kubernetes

  • Kubernetes Informers are so easy... to misuse!

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

About the Role

Render is looking for a Developer Community Lead to grow our community and engagement with developers across the platforms where they spend their time: X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Discord. You will be the public face of Render in these communities, building relationships with developers, creating content that sparks conversation, and turning Render's technical wins into stories the developer community wants to share.

You will:

  • Own Render's day-to-day presence on X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Discord: engage with developers, answer questions, and contribute to relevant conversations

  • Ship a regular cadence of short-form technical content: threads, posts, code snippets, demos, and timely takes on what's happening in the ecosystem

  • Surface and jump into the conversations where Render has a credible voice, fast

  • Build relationships with developer creators, community moderators, and early adopters in Render's ecosystem

  • Partner w/ DevRel to run AMAs, livestreams, and community programs on Discord and Reddit; support hackathons and community activations

  • Produce longer-form technical content (blog posts, videos, sample apps) designed to fuel social distribution

  • Occasionally represent Render at conferences, meetups, and on podcasts when the audience fit is right

  • Track impact through community growth, engagement, sentiment, and downstream signups; double down on what works

We're looking for:

  • 5-8+ years in developer marketing, community management, content creation, or a hands-on engineering role with a strong public side

  • An active, established presence on at least one major developer platform (X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitch, or similar) with a portfolio of content you can point to

  • Strong technical foundation: comfortable with modern infrastructure, web frameworks, and shipping working code

  • Native fluency in developer communities online: you know what plays on X versus Reddit versus Discord, and you can hold a strong point of view without being preachy

  • Sharp written voice

  • Bias toward shipping fast and iterating

Nice-to-haves:

  • Existing relationships with developer creators and community moderators

  • Track record of growing a developer audience from scratch

  • Comfort on camera or behind a mic

  • Experience with developer cloud, hosting, or infrastructure products

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

Render is hiring a Solutions Engineer to own the technical side of our pre-sales motion. This is a foundational role on the go-to-market team, joining at a pivotal moment: Heroku has transitioned to maintenance-focused support, and a large cohort of developers and engineering teams is looking for a modern home. You'll be the technical force behind how we win that business—and new business more broadly—serving as the credible, hands-on engineer that prospects need to see before they make an infrastructure decision.

You'll work closely with Account Executives across the full sales cycle: leading discovery, architecting solutions, running proof-of-concepts, and guiding migrations. You'll be equally comfortable pairing with a senior engineer on a complex Heroku migration and presenting a platform overview to a VP of Engineering. This role reports to the Head of Technical Sales.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects—uncovering infrastructure requirements, architecture constraints, scale targets, and migration complexity to build a clear path to Render

  • Deliver customized product demonstrations that map Render's capabilities directly to each prospect's use case, including persistent compute, autoscaling, Postgres, background workers, cron jobs, preview environments, and Blueprints

  • Architect and run proof-of-concept deployments that prove Render can handle real production workloads—LLM-powered applications, multi-service stacks, async pipelines, and beyond

  • Serve as the go-to technical expert for prospects migrating from Heroku, including teams with complex multi-dyno architectures, large Postgres databases, and third-party add-on dependencies

  • Develop and maintain migration playbooks, demo environments, and POC templates that reduce time-to-value for prospects and enable the broader team to move faster

  • Handle technical objections and competitive comparisons—including against AWS, GCP, Railway, and Fly.io—with honest, well-reasoned arguments that build trust

  • Respond to technical sections of RFPs and security questionnaires with accuracy and speed

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to build multi-stakeholder consensus across engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure decision-makers

  • Synthesize field feedback into structured product input for Engineering and Product, helping prioritize the roadmap based on what's winning and losing deals

  • Contribute to technical marketing content—migration guides, blog posts, webinars—that builds Render's credibility with developer audiences

What We're Looking For

  • Has 8+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales role at a cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer tools company

  • Has deep, hands-on familiarity with at least one major PaaS platform (Heroku, Render, Railway, Fly.io, or similar)—you've deployed real applications, not just read the docs

  • Is proficient across the modern web application stack: web servers, background workers, databases (Postgres especially), caching layers, CI/CD pipelines, and container-based deployments

  • Can write code—Python, Ruby, Node.js, Go, or similar—well enough to debug a customer's failing deploy, adapt a code sample, or build a POC integration

  • Understands networking fundamentals—private networking, egress control, TLS, custom domains—which are common friction points in migration evaluations

  • Is an excellent communicator: equally comfortable presenting to a VP of Engineering and pairing with a developer on a tricky migration issue

  • Has a track record of managing multiple simultaneous technical evaluations without sacrificing quality or responsiveness

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and is excited to help shape process as a foundational member of the team

Nice-to-Haves

  • Direct experience migrating production workloads from Heroku to any alternative platform

  • Familiarity with Render's product suite—Blueprints (render.yaml), Preview Environments, private services, and managed Postgres

  • Experience with AI/ML workloads: LLM inference endpoints, GPU compute, vector databases, or model serving—a fast-growing and strategically important segment of Render's customer base

  • Background in technical content creation: migration guides, architecture blog posts, YouTube tutorials, or conference talks

  • Exposure to IaC tools (Terraform, Pulumi) and how they interact with PaaS abstractions

  • Experience in a quota-carrying or quota-influenced pre-sales role at a high-velocity startup

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About the role

You'll own the path from commit to running production software on Render: the build system, the deploy experience, and the primitives that make delivery composable, including reusable build artifacts, multi-service deployment, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure as code. In practice, you own the part of our customers' SDLC that Render is responsible for, and the developer productivity outcomes that come with it.

This is a high-leverage area. The simplicity of the build and deploy experience is one of the main reasons developers choose Render, and it's also where our fastest-growing customers feel the most pain as they scale. Slow builds, redundant rebuilds, and hard-to-diagnose failures show up directly in developer engagement and in retention. The loop is also changing shape: more of the code arriving on Render isn't written by a human, which changes what a deploy is, who is waiting on it, and what has to be true before it goes out.

You'll work with a dedicated engineering team and partner closely with infrastructure, design, customer success, and go-to-market. Your customers span the full spectrum: solo developers deploying their first service, fast-growing startups shipping daily, and platform teams running hundreds of services across growing engineering orgs.

What you'll do

  • Shape build and deploy experiences that feel simple from hundred-line prototypes to architectures with hundreds of services, and work seamlessly whether the thing shipping code is a person or an AI agent.

  • Own the build and deploy system end to end. Set the roadmap and own the outcomes: build and deploy speed, deploy success rate, and time to diagnose a failure.

  • Define and ship foundational primitives such as reusable build artifacts and application-level deployment, rather than accumulating one-off features.

  • Drive build and deploy performance work: caching, incremental builds, monorepo workflows, and build compute options for workloads that need more capacity.

  • Make failures fast to diagnose: failure classification, surfacing root cause at the point of failure rather than buried in logs, and the metrics that tell us whether debuggability is improving.

  • Talk to customers constantly, translate what you hear into patterns across the customer base, and decide what to build now, later, or not at all.

  • Work with engineering to sequence foundational refactors against urgent customer needs, and defend those tradeoffs to stakeholders.

  • Partner with customer success and sales on at-risk accounts: decide what we commit to, what gets a workaround, and how we communicate both.

Who you are

  • You have 6+ years of product management experience, with time spent on developer tools, infrastructure, or platform products.

  • You have significant depth in the delivery domain: CI/CD, build systems and caching, containers and registries, deploy strategies (canary, blue-green, rollbacks, health checks, zero-downtime deploys), and infrastructure as code. You can hold your own in an architecture conversation and tell a load-bearing technical constraint from a preference.

  • You set direction that holds up over multiple quarters, drive alignment across engineering, design, and go-to-market without owning those teams, and raise the bar for how product work gets done around you.

  • You think in primitives and platforms. When a customer asks for a one-off fix, you look for the reusable capability underneath it.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and limited data. You form opinions from customer conversations, analytics, and technical constraints, and you can defend a prioritization under capacity limits.

  • You communicate clearly with everyone from a platform engineer evaluating your build system to a CTO asking about competitor benchmarks, and you know how to say no while preserving trust.

  • You obsess over developer experience and hold a high bar for speed, reliability, and legibility in the tools you ship.

Nice to have

  • Experience with product-led growth motions or products serving both self-serve users and larger accounts.

  • Hands-on experience as a software engineer.

  • Experience taking a platform primitive from design partner beta through general availability.

Why Render

You'll own one of the most consequential surfaces of a platform that millions of developers rely on, with a direct line from your decisions to whether fast-growing companies can scale. You'll work on hard problems for a customer base that will tell you exactly what's wrong with what you shipped. The core delivery primitives here are still being defined, and the ones you land will be what teams build on for years.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own the path from commit to running production software on Render: the build system, the deploy experience, and the primitives that make delivery composable, including reusable build artifacts, multi-service deployment, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure as code. In practice, you own the part of our customers' SDLC that Render is responsible for, and the developer productivity outcomes that come with it.

This is a high-leverage area. The simplicity of the build and deploy experience is one of the main reasons developers choose Render, and it's also where our fastest-growing customers feel the most pain as they scale. Slow builds, redundant rebuilds, and hard-to-diagnose failures show up directly in developer engagement and in retention. The loop is also changing shape: more of the code arriving on Render isn't written by a human, which changes what a deploy is, who is waiting on it, and what has to be true before it goes out.

You'll work with a dedicated engineering team and partner closely with infrastructure, design, customer success, and go-to-market. Your customers span the full spectrum: solo developers deploying their first service, fast-growing startups shipping daily, and platform teams running hundreds of services across growing engineering orgs.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Shape build and deploy experiences that feel simple from hundred-line prototypes to architectures with hundreds of services, and work seamlessly whether the thing shipping code is a person or an AI agent.

 - Own the build and deploy system end to end. Set the roadmap and own the outcomes: build and deploy speed, deploy success rate, and time to diagnose a failure.

 - Define and ship foundational primitives such as reusable build artifacts and application-level deployment, rather than accumulating one-off features.

 - Drive build and deploy performance work: caching, incremental builds, monorepo workflows, and build compute options for workloads that need more capacity.

 - Make failures fast to diagnose: failure classification, surfacing root cause at the point of failure rather than buried in logs, and the metrics that tell us whether debuggability is improving.

 - Talk to customers constantly, translate what you hear into patterns across the customer base, and decide what to build now, later, or not at all.

 - Work with engineering to sequence foundational refactors against urgent customer needs, and defend those tradeoffs to stakeholders.

 - Partner with customer success and sales on at-risk accounts: decide what we commit to, what gets a workaround, and how we communicate both.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 6+ years of product management experience, with time spent on developer tools, infrastructure, or platform products.

 - You have significant depth in the delivery domain: CI/CD, build systems and caching, containers and registries, deploy strategies (canary, blue-green, rollbacks, health checks, zero-downtime deploys), and infrastructure as code. You can hold your own in an architecture conversation and tell a load-bearing technical constraint from a preference.

 - You set direction that holds up over multiple quarters, drive alignment across engineering, design, and go-to-market without owning those teams, and raise the bar for how product work gets done around you.

 - You think in primitives and platforms. When a customer asks for a one-off fix, you look for the reusable capability underneath it.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity and limited data. You form opinions from customer conversations, analytics, and technical constraints, and you can defend a prioritization under capacity limits.

 - You communicate clearly with everyone from a platform engineer evaluating your build system to a CTO asking about competitor benchmarks, and you know how to say no while preserving trust.

 - You obsess over developer experience and hold a high bar for speed, reliability, and legibility in the tools you ship.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with product-led growth motions or products serving both self-serve users and larger accounts.

 - Hands-on experience as a software engineer.

 - Experience taking a platform primitive from design partner beta through general availability.


WHY RENDER

You'll own one of the most consequential surfaces of a platform that millions of developers rely on, with a direct line from your decisions to whether fast-growing companies can scale. You'll work on hard problems for a customer base that will tell you exactly what's wrong with what you shipped. The core delivery primitives here are still being defined, and the ones you land will be what teams build on for years.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

 - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

 - 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

 - Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

 - Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager for Product Engineers, you will lead a group of talented builders creating the core developer experience of the Render platform. This role blends strong technical leadership with product thinking: you’ll partner closely with product managers and designers to translate user needs into high-quality, scalable systems that developers rely on every day. You’ll be responsible for guiding technical direction, developing engineers, and ensuring the team ships meaningful improvements quickly while maintaining the high standards that define Render’s platform. The ideal candidate brings a strong engineering background, a deep sense of ownership, and a passion for building products that developers love.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead and grow a team of product engineers, supporting their development through mentorship, feedback, and clear technical guidance.

  • Drive execution on key product initiatives from ideation through launch, balancing speed with high standards of reliability and quality.

  • Partner closely with Product and Design teams to translate customer needs into thoughtful technical solutions and product roadmaps.

  • Engage deeply in technical discussions, guiding system design decisions and helping the team navigate architectural tradeoffs.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across engineering practices and team processes.

  • Help the team break down complex problems into incremental milestones that deliver value quickly while supporting long-term platform evolution.

  • Ensure teams maintain a strong understanding of the developer experience and customer impact of the features they build.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with product management, customers, and internal teams to understand needs, align priorities, and ensure delivery of impactful features and solutions.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years as an Engineer shipping products and/or features that have downstream impact on the business and product ecosystem

  • 2+ years of experience managing people and developing engineers, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management.

  • Strong technical background with the ability to engage deeply in system design, architecture, and engineering tradeoffs.

  • Product-oriented mindset with experience translating business goals and user needs into engineering roadmaps and shipped features.

  • Ability to balance urgency with thoughtful execution, helping teams ship quickly while maintaining high quality.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both team outcomes and long-term system health.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience building products for developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DevTools.

  • Background working on highly scalable distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.

  • Experience improving engineering velocity through tooling, processes, and team practices.

  • Experience building products used directly by developers or technical users.

  • A track record of successful collaboration with product, marketing, and customer support teams to drive adoption and retention.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

About the Role

The Workplace Experience Manager is responsible for creating and maintaining a productive, welcoming, and engaging environment for employees, guests, and partners across Render’s San Francisco office and distributed workforce. This role is part of the People team and owns day-to-day office operations, onboarding support, employee engagement initiatives, and coordination of team onsites while partnering closely with People Operations, IT, and cross-functional teams.

This role is onsite five days per week in the San Francisco office.

What You'll Do

Office Operations & Workplace Management

  • Own the daily operations and overall employee experience of the San Francisco office

  • Ensure the office is consistently organized, stocked, functional, and guest-ready

  • Greet visitors, manage deliveries, and serve as the primary onsite point of contact

  • Manage relationships with building management, engineers, janitorial staff, and office vendors

  • Oversee office maintenance, repairs, and workplace improvement projects

  • Partner with IT to maintain meeting room technology and troubleshoot basic office technology issues

  • Manage office seating, desk assignments, badge/access coordination, and workspace logistics

  • Oversee workplace services including catering, snacks, beverages, supplies, and inventory management

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve workplace processes, systems, and employee experience

Employee Engagement & Culture

  • Lead employee engagement initiatives that foster connection, collaboration, and community across onsite and remote employees

  • Manage internal programs such as Ops in Action, employee appreciation initiatives, and holiday gifting

  • Plan and execute office celebrations, seasonal events, happy hours, and team-building activities

  • Expand and support hybrid and virtual engagement opportunities for distributed employees

  • Partner with leadership and People Operations to strengthen company culture through meaningful experiences and programming

Onboarding & Employee Support

  • Partner with People Operations to support onboarding logistics for new hires

  • Coordinate workspace setup, office access, swag distribution, and first-day office experience for local employees

  • Assist with equipment coordination and onboarding session scheduling

  • Help streamline onboarding processes and improve the overall new hire experience

  • Serve as an approachable onsite resource for employees and visitors

Team Onsites & Event Support

  • Plan and coordinate team onsites and smaller internal gatherings

  • Manage logistics including venue coordination, catering, transportation, accommodations, schedules, and office setup

  • Support teams in creating engaging and organized in-person experiences

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth onsite execution

  • Provide operational and logistical support for larger company events such as Rendervous (all company events) and other major engagements as needed

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in office management, workplace operations, facilities coordination, or a related administrative/people-facing role

  • Proven ability to manage vendor and building management relationships (janitorial, maintenance, engineers, catering, etc.)

  • Experience planning and executing workplace events such as team celebrations, onsites, or company gatherings of varying size

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams (seating logistics, inventory, onboarding, events) without dropping the ball

  • Comfortable being the onsite point of contact and handling ambiguity or last-minute changes independently

  • Proficiency with workplace tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, and basic IT troubleshooting for AV/meeting room tech

  • Clear, professional communication with employees, vendors, and leadership alike

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting a People or HR team, particularly onboarding coordination or new hire programming

  • Familiarity with coordinating distributed or hybrid workforces, not just onsite employees

  • Prior experience managing budgets for office supplies, catering, or event spend

  • Exposure to badge/access management systems or workplace platforms (e.g., Envoy, Robin, or similar)

  • Experience supporting large-scale company events or offsites

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision and roadmap for Render's datastores portfolio, with our Postgres offering at the center. You will define what a modern managed database experience looks like, including how database products will adapt to new state patterns from agents and how agents as users of state-keeping products should be accommodated.

You'll drive the technical and strategic direction for Render Postgres and our broader data layer, working directly with your team and infrastructure engineering to shape architectural decisions. You'll engage with Render's customers and our product development teams to develop a deep understanding of their data needs and build conviction about where the datastores portfolio needs to go next.

What You'll Do

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Render's datastores, anchored on Postgres. Your scope spans provisioning and lifecycle management, high availability and disaster recovery, backups and point-in-time recovery, scaling and performance, connection management, and the extension ecosystem.

  • Drive prioritization across Render's data investments, balancing the leverage of foundational reliability work — replication, failover, storage performance — against near-term product and business needs, and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs.

  • Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's data layer, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for durability, performance, and operational simplicity. Databases are where customer trust is won or lost, so an instinct for reliability and data safety is essential.

  • Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how managed Postgres needs to evolve to serve AI-native builders — from vector workloads and retrieval pipelines to databases that are spun up, branched, and torn down programmatically by agents at scale.

  • Set the standard for how developers experience data on Render, providing clear guidance, sensible defaults, and abstractions that make it easy for teams to run production databases with confidence — without needing a DBA on staff.

We're looking for

  • 7+ years in Product Management, with the majority spent on databases, data infrastructure, developer tools, or platform products.

  • Familiarity with Postgres — its architecture, operational model, ecosystem, and the tradeoffs teams face running it in production. Bonus if you have strong perspective on how agentic workloads and AI-native applications are reshaping database usage patterns.

  • Deep developer empathy, for both internal engineering teams and our customers, and the technical depth to make sound architectural tradeoffs in collaboration with engineering.

  • A track record of taking ambiguous, high-stakes reliability and infrastructure problems and turning them into clear strategy and shipped outcomes.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills.

What would be nice to have but not required

  • Experience as a database engineer, DBA, or infrastructure engineer.

  • Hands-on experience with Postgres internals, replication tooling, or the extension ecosystem (e.g., pgvector, PostGIS).

  • Experience building AI agents or the data infrastructure that powers them.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on Developer Velocity, you'll design and build the internal platform, tooling, and automation that lets every Render engineer move quickly and safely. You'll drive changes in our local development environments, CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and the metrics we use to understand and improve how we ship. You'll work across the entire engineering org, identify where friction lives, and remove it, measurably.

What You'll Do

  • Improve speed and reliability of early change feedback

    • Invest in build and dependency tooling, caching, incremental builds, and monorepo ergonomics, to keep iteration tight as the codebase grows.

    • Accelerate our CI/CD pipelines - cutting build, test, and deploy times while keeping the path to production safe and reversible.

    • Make our test suites fast and trustworthy: parallelization, smart test selection, flaky-test detection, and better local/preview environments built on the same primitives our customers use.

  • Design and build tools to support concurrent agent execution

    • Make test feedback fast enough to live inside an agent's loop, where slow or flaky runs compound across every attempt.

    • Get agents the right context (codebase conventions, service ownership, recent changes, environment state) so their first attempt lands closer to correct.

  • Simplify and establish repeatable patterns

    • Reduce toil through automation, paving over repetitive workflows and manual steps wherever they slow people down.

    • Instrument the engineering org with meaningful signals (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore) and turn them into action.

  • Build and participate in an on-call rotation as the team takes ownership of critical systems.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and operating developer-facing tooling, CI/CD systems, or internal platforms that other engineers depend on every day.

  • Experience driving cultural and process changes to make engineering teams more effective.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping, maintaining, and debugging production systems.

  • Proficiency in Go (or a strong willingness to ramp quickly, it's our primary language).

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (yup, Terraform).

  • A bias toward measurement: you instrument what you build and let data tell you whether you actually made things faster.

  • You empathize deeply with engineers, fixing developer pain points in an elegant and sustainable manner is something that resonates deeply with you.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience improving build systems, test infrastructure, or developer experience at meaningful scale - Bazel, Concourse, and GitHub workflows are old friends.

  • Familiarity with observability tools like Datadog, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Comfort working close to the metal - Linux, containers, kubernetes - you get your hands very dirty.

  • Security-minded instincts, especially around supply chain and the path from commit to deploy.

  • Understanding that the question isn't "AI pilled vs AI skeptic", but rather where to use it as an accelerant, and where human context must come first.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.
